# Fix Maven Compilation Failure: http v0.25 -> v1.1.3

## Context

Project `docker-adapter` (by artipie) has a **COMPILATION_FAILURE** after a dependency upgrade bot bumped
`com.artipie:http` from `v0.25` to `v1.1.3` (other update).

Reference PR: https://github.com/artipie/docker-adapter/pull/511

## Your Task

The source code is in `/docker-adapter`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.

## Steps

1. **Identify errors:**
   ```bash
   cd /docker-adapter && mvn compile -B 2>&1 | grep -E "^\[ERROR\]" | head -60
   ```

2. **Understand breaking changes:** The new version `v1.1.3` has API changes vs `v0.25`.
   Review the failing source files and update calls to match the new API.
   - Old API sources: https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/com/artipie/http/v0.25/http-v0.25-sources.jar
   - New API sources: https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/com/artipie/http/v1.1.3/http-v1.1.3-sources.jar

3. **Apply fixes** to the Java source files in `/docker-adapter`.

4. **Verify:**
   ```bash
   cd /docker-adapter && mvn compile -B -q
   ```

## Success Criteria

`mvn compile` exits with **code 0** (no compilation errors).
I'll help you fix the Maven compilation failure caused by the `com.artipie:http` dependency upgrade. Let me start by identifying the errors.
